description: Keep one fact current: write key: value on an entity, replacing every observation that key already holds, so a drifted twin cannot survive. Use it instead of update_observations when the value changes over time — a version, a status — and you should not have to remember its previous text. An observation belongs to a key when it is exactly the key or starts with the key, a colon and a space, and a key may not itself contain a colon followed by a space. A missing entity fails as add_observations does: create it with create_entities first.

entityName.description: The entity that holds the fact

key.description: The name of the fact, matched at the start of an observation
